components.name: Sidecar Search Action
components.description: The single warm action in the opening composition.

components.name: Mosaic Explorer Search

components.html: <form class="ds-mosaic-search"><label for="ds-query">Search the Sepolia explorer</label><input id="ds-query" placeholder="Search block, tx hash, or address"/><button type="button">Search <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8h9M8.5 4.5 12 8l-3.5 3.5"/></svg></button></form>
components.css: .ds-mosaic-search { position: relative; display: flex; width: min(100%, 780px); min-height: 64px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(243,246,242,.25); border-radius: 15px; padding: 6px; background: rgba(11,15,15,.86); box-shadow: 0 18px 56px rgba(0,0,0,.3); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); transition: border-color 170ms ease, background-color 170ms ease, box-shadow 170ms ease; } .ds-mosaic-search:focus-within { border-color: #08706d; background: rgba(17,21,20,.94); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(3,83,82,.18), 0 18px 56px rgba(0,0,0,.3); } .ds-mosaic-search label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); } .ds-mosaic-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: #f3f6f2; font: 400 17px var(--font-sans, 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif); } .ds-mosaic-search input::placeholder { color: #a1aaa6; } .ds-mosaic-search button { display: inline-flex; width: 120px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: #f3e8bc; color: #05070a; font: 700 16px var(--font-sans, 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif); } .ds-mosaic-search button:hover { background: #fff1c8; } .ds-mosaic-search button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-mosaic-search button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #08706d; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-mosaic-search svg { width: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Home Header Navigation
components.description: The existing BlockScan navigation kept quiet over the mosaic.
components.css: .ds-mosaic-nav { display: flex; min-height: 76px; align-items: center; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(144,154,149,.1); padding: 0 32px; background: rgba(5,7,10,.58); color: #f3f6f2; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif); } .ds-mosaic-nav strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-mosaic-nav > span { display: flex; align-self: stretch; margin-left: auto; } .ds-mosaic-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; color: #909a95; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mosaic-nav a:hover, .ds-mosaic-nav a.is-active { color: #f3f6f2; } .ds-mosaic-nav a.is-active::after { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 0; left: 12px; height: 1px; background: #08706d; content: ''; } .ds-mosaic-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #08706d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-mosaic-nav code { border-left: 1px solid rgba(144,154,149,.16); padding-left: 18px; color: #707a75; font: 500 10px var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); }

components.name: Mosaic Plane
components.description: The art-directed 17-slot desktop wall with a protected central exclusion zone.
components.css: .ds-plane-wrap { position: relative; min-height: 430px; overflow: hidden; background: #05070a; perspective: 1480px; } .ds-plane { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; display: grid; width: 112%; min-width: 760px; height: 92%; grid-template-columns: repeat(5,1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(4,1fr); gap: 12px; transform: translate3d(-50%,-50%,0) rotateX(6deg) rotateZ(-2deg) scale(1.08); transform-style: preserve-3d; } .ds-plane i { border: 1px solid rgba(144,154,149,.18); border-radius: 13px; background: rgba(11,15,15,.9); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.22); opacity: .6; } .ds-plane i:nth-child(2), .ds-plane i:nth-child(5), .ds-plane i:nth-child(6), .ds-plane i:nth-child(9), .ds-plane i:nth-child(12), .ds-plane i:nth-child(17) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #35433c, #0b0f0f 72%); opacity: .72; } .ds-plane i.is-empty { visibility: hidden; } .ds-plane-veil { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 43% 48% at 50% 49%, rgba(5,7,10,.99), rgba(5,7,10,.96) 35%, rgba(5,7,10,.74) 67%, rgba(5,7,10,.18)); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Verified NFT Artwork Tile

components.css: .ds-nft-tile { position: relative; width: 230px; aspect-ratio: 1; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(144,154,149,.18); border-radius: 13px; background: #0b0f0f; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.22); opacity: .72; cursor: default; transition: opacity 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color 240ms ease; } .ds-nft-tile::after { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(5,7,10,.06), rgba(5,7,10,.35)); content: ''; opacity: .62; transition: opacity 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nft-tile img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; filter: brightness(.62) saturate(.72); transition: filter 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nft-tile span { position: absolute; z-index: 2; right: 11px; bottom: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(243,246,242,.18); border-radius: 7px; padding: 5px 8px; background: rgba(5,7,10,.62); color: rgba(243,246,242,.66); font: 500 9px var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-nft-tile:hover { border-color: rgba(144,154,149,.28); opacity: .94; transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.015); } .ds-nft-tile:hover::after { opacity: .12; } .ds-nft-tile:hover img { filter: brightness(.98) saturate(.98); transform: scale(1.015); } } .ds-nft-tile:focus-visible { outline: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-nft-tile, .ds-nft-tile::after, .ds-nft-tile img { transition-duration: .01ms; } .ds-nft-tile:hover, .ds-nft-tile:hover img { transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
BlockScan opens as a centered precision search surrounded by a subdued wall of real onchain context. The mosaic establishes breadth—verified NFT artwork, captured coin prices, Sepolia blocks, transaction hashes, and addresses—while a dark exclusion zone keeps the headline and search unmistakably dominant. It is theatrical in composition but technical in content.

The system is static-first, honest, and quiet. Local artwork and a committed real-data snapshot make the first frame complete without waiting for Alchemy; later values update without reshuffling the art direction. Native scrolling hands the mosaic directly into the existing Live Network Activity section. Market Pulse remains absent under the previously approved product redesign, and the preserved Three.js hero is no longer rendered.
keyCharacteristics: A centered headline, concise support line, and single dominant search action.
A real-data mosaic with fixed positions, a calm central exclusion zone, and intentional edge cropping.
Seventeen desktop tiles, twelve tablet tiles, and eight mobile tiles rather than one squeezed universal grid.
Sidecar Yellow reserved for the primary search action; teal remains structural and atmospheric.
Complete first paint from local WebPs and a committed snapshot, followed by quiet shared-data updates.
Decorative motion is fine-pointer-only, scroll-native, reduced-motion-safe, and subordinate to search.

rules.name: The One Yellow Action Rule
rules.body: Sidecar Yellow belongs to Search in the opening composition; never distribute it across mosaic tiles or passive data.

rules.name: The Teal Is Structure Rule
rules.body: Teal establishes identity, focus, and geometry at low volume; it does not tint artwork or become a generic neon Web3 glow.

rules.name: The Center Speaks Once Rule
rules.body: Keep the hero to its exact headline, one support sentence, and search; add no eyebrow, chips, prompts, or second CTA.

rules.name: The Data Keeps Its Cadence Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Mono and tabular numerals for exact or changing values; keep explanations and navigation in Manrope.

rules.name: The Search Owns the Center Rule
rules.body: No bright artwork, large price, or interactive tile may enter the central headline-and-search exclusion zone.

rules.name: The Density Steps Down Rule
rules.body: Curate 17/12/8 tiles across desktop/tablet/mobile; never squeeze the desktop wall into a smaller viewport.

rules.name: The Plane Creates Depth Rule
rules.body: Treat the mosaic as one receding wall; never replace its calm perspective with per-tile parallax, floating motion, or heavy glass effects.

dos: Do preserve the exact headline, support sentence, placeholder, and Search label.
Do keep the complete first frame available from local WebPs and the committed real-data snapshot.
Do reuse the single Home `useRecentBlocks` feed and the one-shot four-symbol price request.
Do keep the mosaic decorative, hidden from assistive technology, and visually subordinate to semantic search.
Do keep the old Three.js source preserved but unrendered while the Explorer Mosaic is the approved Home hero.
Do hand directly into the unchanged Live Network Activity section through native scrolling.
donts: Don't restore Market Pulse; it remains absent under the approved redesign.
Don't fetch NFT artwork at runtime, substitute the six locked selections, or imply collection endorsement.
Don't invent prices, changes, block numbers, hashes, addresses, or freshness claims.
Don't add duplicate polling, per-coin requests, loading skeletons, shimmers, spinners, or hero error banners.
Don't add AI-composer controls, prompt chips, another CTA, wallet connection, or NFT search to the hero field.
Don't add per-tile parallax, pointer tilt, touch hover simulation, bounce, or scroll motion that survives reduced motion.
